real_device_measurements.initial_observations: HDA 48/96 kHz at 256 samples and initial HDA 192 kHz at 512 samples: plain/rolling-locate/loop all had zero engine/backend XRUN deltas and continuous finite nonzero output. Earlier warm Scarlett 48 kHz/256 runs also passed all three modes.
real_device_measurements.final_192k_256: 392 backend XRUNs and insufficient frame coverage with build/scenario work stopped. Earlier runs also failed; empty-session control had 105 backend XRUNs. Independent aplay with matching period/three-period buffer had 10 underruns during VM compilation and 1 after compilation stopped.
real_device_measurements.final_192k_512: Plain and loop had zero engine/backend XRUNs. Rolling locate had 20 engine callback deadline overruns, zero backend XRUNs, and continuous frame coverage. Initial 512-sample runs had zero in both counters; no blanket zero-XRUN claim is made.
real_device_measurements.final_192k_1024: Plain, three rolling locates and loop each had zero engine/backend XRUNs, continuous finite nonzero output, and zero fill errors. Mean callback times were 2092.3, 2028.5 and 2052.4 us respectively (39.2%, 38.0%, 38.5% of period).
real_device_measurements.counter_meaning: Engine XRUN counts callback wall time above the buffer period; backend XRUN counts actual ALSA recovery. A harness exit of zero checks continuity and stream health but does not require zero XRUN counters.
